body: Slice-1 dependency question before edits: requirement (b) cannot compile under the approved four paths as the build stands. laws.AddressGens is in laws/src/main; codec has no dependency on laws, and laws correctly does not depend on codec. Clean option: announce/reserve build.sbt and add a test-only codec -> laws compile dependency, then import AddressGens.address/given in CodecSuite. This creates no cycle (laws has no codec dependency) and avoids duplicating a weaker generator. Alternative is to expand the slice into laws/build restructuring, which is larger. Please explicitly ok the one-line test-only build.sbt dependency and reservation; until then I will implement only the production codec and adversarial deterministic tests, leaving the required property import pending.
